title: chore(objectql, plugin-sharing): one PackageScopedNameRefusedError class for the 409 a package-scoped by-name read refuses with
body:
domain:server#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQKZzp4DLtqiCkZZRM

Found in the contract review of E8 #31680 (PR #31847, record 6734365312, nits N1, N2 and N4). Nothing here blocks E8. All three are follow-ups.

## What is split

- **N2**: after PR #31847, `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` exists twice: in `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/package-scoped-declarations.ts` (around line 229, from E4) and in the new `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-read.ts`. Both have the same name and the same 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` envelope, but `instanceof` against one never matches the other. No cross-package catcher exists today, so nothing is wrong yet. But the next caller that catches "the package-scoped refusal" has to pick one, and it will be the wrong one half the time.
- **N4**: the lean entry `@objectstack/objectql/core` exports `SchemaRegistry`, whose `getApp` now throws that class, but not the class itself, so a lean consumer can only match it by `code` and `status`.
- **N1**: `packages/cli/scripts/check-app-nav-i18n.mjs:909` calls `engine.registry.getApp(app.name)` with no package and no catch. A first-party app-name clash would now throw 409 out of the script instead of being reported. It cannot happen today (every first-party app has one holder).

## Ask

1. One class, declared once at the lowest package both use (`@objectstack/core`, beside `resolvePackageScopedHolders`, unless the reader finds a better home). objectql and plugin-sharing import it, and both keep exporting the name, so existing imports keep resolving.
2. The class is exported from `@objectstack/objectql/core` as well.
3. `check-app-nav-i18n.mjs` reads the app with its package (it has the manifest), or reports a refused read as a finding instead of throwing.
4. Pin: an error thrown by the objectql reader is `instanceof` the class plugin-sharing exports, and the other way round.

`Clause-②: yes (widening)` (a new export on core and on the lean entry), `Metadata-protocol: none`, `patch`.

Blocked-by: #31680 (PR #31847).
